description: Answers questions about Envoyant with answers Envoyant approved. Returns a text approved by Envoyant, unchanged; nothing is generated. Do not include personal details.

answerId.description: Optional. The answerId (a UUID) of one of the suggestedQuestions of an earlier result, to get that answer.

language.description: Optional. BCP 47 language of the question, e.g. "en" or "nl".

name: ask_question
